blocks.html: Calling all kids and kids at heart, get your baskets and be ready as Robinsons Malls hold its annual fun and exciting Easter celebration on April 16. Join in the different activities and games where the whole family can spend time together and win exciting prizes. Topping off the list of activities are the Easter Egg Hunting and Arts and Crafts Workshop where kids can let their imagination run. For entertainment, kids can be amazed and be amused as they watch amazing magic shows. Kids can also get to enjoy the different games wherein they can get cool prizes. Parents can bring their kids to these activities to participating malls such as Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Town Malabon, Robinsons Las Piñas, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Malolos, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Place General Trias, Robinsons Town Malls Los Baños, Robinsons Ilocos and Robinsons Place Tagum. In Robinsons Antipolo, a sweet treats corner also await the kids where they can eat their favorite candies and chocolates. Registration for these activities in these malls is absolutely free which starts at 10:00 a.m. In Robinsons Ilocos, on the other hand, kids aged 4-12 years old can join in the fun by presenting a minimum receipt of ₱500.00 from April 15 to 16 until 1 p.m. Robinsons Imus and Robinsons Dasmariña, on other hand, will also hold their own set of activities for the family. In Robinsons Imus, kids can also watch amazing Puppets Shows and join the Balloon Twists where they can shape their own balloons. Then, in Robinsons Dasmariñas, the kids get to make and design their own Easter Bunny bag. In Robinsons Bacolod, fun games and surprises can be expected with freebies and delicious snacks on the side. To join, registrants from Robinsons Imus can register for free at 10 a.m. while those from Robinsons Bacolod and Robinsons Dasmariñas can join in the fun by simply presenting a minimum receipt worth ₱500.00 on the day. In Robinsons Galleria Cebu, the first 200 children up to 12 years old can win great prizes when they join different contests. Robinsons Lipa, Robinsons Fuente, Robinsons Cybergate Cebu, Robinsons Roxas and Robinsons Butuan will also celebrate Easter with fun-filled activities for everyone. In Robinsons Lipa, kids aged 3-12 can enjoy taking pictures at the photo booths and bring out their creative side while doing face paintings. They can also get their cotton candy and popcorn at the stalls when they go hungry after a day’s activities. Registration for these activities is free and starts at 10:00 a.m. Robinsons Fuente and Robinsons Cybergate Cebu, on the other hand, holds a series of contests and games for the kids to join in such as the Egg Coloring Contest and the Best Easter Costume. Registration starts at 11 a.m. and the first 100 registrants can get free Easter loot bags. In Robinsons Roxas, on the other hand, the kids can experience feeding the rabbits and treat them as their pets for a day while in Robinsons Butuan, “egg-sciting” games and prizes await the whole family. To join, a minimum receipt of ₱1000.00 is all you need. For VIP card holders, present your card together with the receipt in Robinsons Butuan on April 11 to get 1 free ticket. The fun doesn’t stop there, as Robinsons Bacolod, Robinsons Sta. Rosa and Summit Ridge Promenade also hold their own Easter celebration with a series of fun activities. Workshops for the kids to do such as the Bunny Basket Making Workshop, Popsicle Stick Picture Frame Making Workshop and the Bunny Gift Bag Making Workshop await the kids. Participants can also opt for pictures at the Photo Studio, Bunny Photo Corner and Souvenir Photo Studio. Fun-filled kiddie games also await the kids on April 16. Registration for both malls starts at 11:00 a.m. where the first 100 registrants can get Easter loot bags. If your kids want more activities, bring them to Robinsons Iloilo and Robinsons Antique where they can join their event dubbed as “The Grand Easter Carousel”. Kids aged 4 to 8 can join several events such as the Easter Egg Pool, Balloon Twisting Booth and a lot more. Other activities include the Egg hunting, where the first 100 kids get to look for the special eggs around the place, and Egg Painting where the first 20 kids get to design their own set of eggs. Interested participants just need to present a single-receipt purchase from April 10 to 16 to register and to get a free Easter Egg candy. For participants in Robinsons Iloilo, simply present a single receipt worth ₱3000.00 for registration. The Easter Celebration at Robinsons doesn’t end there for Robinsons Jaro and Robinsons Gensan have their own treats for the kids. In Robinsons Jaro, kids can enjoy several fun activities and get unlimited cotton candy and popcorn when you register your kids aged 4 to 8 and present a minimum receipt worth ₱1000.00. In Robinsons Gensan, exciting and “egg-straspecial” activities await the kids aged 3 to 10. Registration is free but for the “egg-straspecial” activities, 15 kids can be accommodated with a minimum receipt from April 1, 8, 9, 15 and 16 worth ₱300.00. Finally, if you are looking for activities where the whole family can participate, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Pangasinan and Robinsons Novaliches got you covered. In Robinsons Luisita and Robinsons Place Pangasinan, games for a family of three (3) are to be expected. Enjoy a fun-filled day with your loved ones as you join Group Relays, Egg Hunting and so much more. Registration in Robinsons Luisita starts on April 3 and a minimum purchase of 300 is needed to join. On the other hand, registration in Robinsons Place Pangasinan is free for the first 500 registrants. For the next registrants, simply present asingle receipt worth ₱500.00 to join. And in Robinsons Novaliches, the family can participate in a series of games such as Jumbo Easter Memory, Pin the Tail on the Rabbit, Wonderful World of Easter, Half-Egg Stack and Bunny Bowling. Great prizes await the teams such as Robinsons Gift Certificates worth ₱1000.00 as the grand prize and grocery baskets worth ₱300.00 as consolation prizes. Kids can also enjoy different kiddie games wherein they can win coloring sets worth ₱300.00 as the grand prize and candy packs worth ₱50.00 as consolation prizes. Interested participants can join by simply presenting their single-receipt worth ₱500.00 at the information booth located in Level 1, Expansion Building on April 10 to 15 from 10 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. and on April 16 from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. To know more about other Robinsons Malls Easter events and Summer activities, follow Robinsons Malls on Facebook: www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter: @RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial.
